subject: Error: Failed to create the shared library.

messages.author: 519f3b688f6efebd
messages.subject: Error: Failed to create the shared library.
parts:
Hello, 

All models that I could run successfully run previous fail to run. I get the rror "Failed to create the shared library". When I do "printErrors()" I get Error in system(paste(MAKE,p1(paste("-f",shQuote(makefiles))),"compilers"),: "make" not found. 
calls:<Anonymous>->.shlib_internal->system
Execution halted.  

Could any one indicate what has happened and how to resolve the issue?
Many thanks,
Nellie

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Error: Failed to create the shared library.
parts:
Hi Nellie,
Have there been any updates or changes to your system? That sounds like a problem finding command-line tools for compilation/building workflows.
Can you think of anything else that has changed? Did this breakage coincide with an update to nimble? Any context you can provide might give a clue.
Best wishes,
Perry
